import 'package:analytics/analytics.dart';
import 'package:context/context.dart';
import 'package:web_server/web_server.dart';

Future<void> main() async {
  final analytics = Analytics();
  final base = Context().withAnalytics(analytics);
  final firstExchange = HttpExchange();
  final secondExchange = HttpExchange();
  final first = base.withHttp(firstExchange);
  final second = base.withHttp(secondExchange);

  if (!identical(first.analytics, analytics) ||
      !identical(second.analytics, analytics)) {
    throw StateError('Requests lost the shared analytics capability');
  }
  if (!identical(first.http, firstExchange) ||
      !identical(second.http, secondExchange)) {
    throw StateError('Requests lost their independent exchange bindings');
  }

  await Future.wait([handle(first, 'first'), handle(second, 'second')]);
  if (firstExchange.responses.single != 'Hello first' ||
      secondExchange.responses.single != 'Hello second') {
    throw StateError('Request responses crossed context branches');
  }
  if (analytics.events.length != 2 ||
      !analytics.events.contains('first') ||
      !analytics.events.contains('second')) {
    throw StateError('Shared analytics did not capture both requests');
  }

  final replacement = first.withHttp(HttpExchange());
  if (identical(replacement.http, firstExchange) ||
      !identical(first.http, firstExchange) ||
      !identical(second.http, secondExchange)) {
    throw StateError('HTTP replacement changed another context');
  }
  try {
    base.http;
    throw StateError('Request setup mutated the base context');
  } on MissingContextValue catch (error) {
    if (error.debugName != 'http') rethrow;
  }

  final reversed = Context().withHttp(firstExchange).withAnalytics(analytics);
  if (!identical(reversed.analytics, analytics) ||
      !identical(reversed.http, firstExchange)) {
    throw StateError('Capability composition depends on setup order');
  }
}

Future<void> handle(Context context, String request) async {
  context.analytics.track(request);
  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  context.http.respond('Hello $request');
}
